prompt:
Use case: seasonal edit of an existing painting.
Asset type: a precisely composition-matched Halloween-night state of an existing ambient video-game scene. It will be slowly composited directly over the original painting, so geometric registration is critical.
Input image: the supplied the-last-chapter-night.png is the EDIT TARGET, not a loose reference. Original canvas is 1672 by 941 pixels, approximately 16:9 landscape. Keep the same full image framing, aspect ratio, view, perspective, object scale and positions.
Preserve the original illustration, composition and every landmark contour as closely as possible: the bookshelves, desk lamp, mug and books at left, the armchair with cushion and red throw, the curtain, the terracotta pot, the candle lantern on its stone block, the side table with books, the bougainvillea and stone walls, the bay, islands, harbour town, moored boat and every harbour light. Do not redraw or reinterpret their shapes.
Add, painted in exactly the same hand-painted style, brushwork and palette so they look like they were always part of it:
- Four carved jack-o'-lanterns resting naturally: one on the stone block beside the candle lantern, one small one on the stack of books on the side table, one on top of the stone wall by the bougainvillea, and one on the terrace floor near the armchair. Sizes matched to depth. Gentle, friendly carvings (simple smiling faces, one with a crescent moon), lit from within by warm candlelight, casting amber light onto the stone and books, with believable contact shadows.
- A large, soft, warm harvest moon over the bay in the open sky above the existing silver light path on the water, so the path reads as its reflection.
- Three or four very small bat silhouettes near the moon.
- A short string of small orange lanterns along the harbour promenade, and a few autumn leaves on the terrace.
Lighting and palette: keep the existing evening palette and mood; the jack-o'-lanterns join the existing warm lights. Cosy and inviting, not scary.
Strict constraints: identical camera and composition; do not crop, zoom or move edges; do not change water geometry, silhouettes or existing objects; no skulls, ghosts, witches, cobwebs, gravestones, characters, text, legible signs, graphics, watermark or UI. Paint no rain streaks, falling snow or floating particles (those animate in code). Preserve fine spatial detail and edges. Deliver one complete landscape image at the same size.
assessment: A 50/50 blend with its source shows no doubled edges on landmarks, shorelines or water; only the added Halloween objects differ.
